"The Echoes Released by the Silence of Science."

The world runs on three independent systems: the physical, the ethereal, and the potential. At their base levels, they interact with each other as nothing more than ghosts -- a bare acknowledgement that there exists something more. It is perhaps for the best that things are kept at that bare acknowledgement, as when high energies are involved things get downright frightening.

We are all familiar with the realm of the physical, for it is the sole realm that humans can tangibly interact and witness. It is the natural domain of science and observation, although scientific principles can still be done to the other systems their behaviors are more alien than the physical realm. Still the physical realm is perhaps the most calm, since to put it simply, "it is what it is."

The ethereal realm is where things get scary. This is the realm of what we could call magic: conjuration, teleportation, charms, and more. Whereas science obverses and interacts with the matter and energy of the universe, magic obverses and interacts with the data and information of the universe itself. It does not concern itself with natural laws on what is flammable, for it can simply go on to say that something is flammable, and it is so. Perhaps the most frightening aspect is the energy differential between physics and magic: it is infinite. On paper, magic might be limited by the laws of physics, but when you can throw around infinities like Halloween candy then you can disregard a few laws.

Still neither of them compares to potentia. The best way to describe potentia is that it is the energy of infinity itself. If magic is infinitely more energetic than physics, then potentia is infinitely more energetic than magic. It is not a realm that is oft seen, for it controls all of possibility and probability. Whereas magic is tenuously limited by the laws of physics, potentia is not limited at all, for potentia is the rulebook.
